hints.tr: Sırası `p` olan harfin karşılığının sırası `25 - p`.
hints.en: The letter at position `p` maps to position `25 - p`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def atbash(text):
    result = ""
    for ch in text:
        if ch.isalpha() and ch.isascii():
            base = ord("A") if ch.isupper() else ord("a")
            result += chr(25 - (ord(ch) - base) + base)
        else:
            result += ch
    return result

print(atbash("abc xyz"))
print(atbash("Hello, World!"))
print(atbash(atbash("secret")))
```

The full solution:

```python
def atbash(text):
    result = ""
    for ch in text:
        if ch.isalpha() and ch.isascii():
            base = ord("A") if ch.isupper() else ord("a")
            result += chr(25 - (ord(ch) - base) + base)
        else:
            result += ch
    return result

print(atbash("abc xyz"))
print(atbash("Hello, World!"))
print(atbash(atbash("secret")))
```
